description: Shows a page the way an AI agent reads it: the raw HTML a crawler without JavaScript gets, the rendered page text, the accessibility tree (roles and accessible names of controls) and the WebMCP tools the page registers. Use it to explain why an agent or AI answer misses content, or before a journey. Needs the Chrome extension. A null part could not be read, and an empty tool list means the page registers no WebMCP tools.

url.description: The page to read, an absolute http or https URL such as https://example.com/.

name: see_as_agent
title: See a page as an agent
